feature: Private same-device installed dependency backup and offline restore

implementation.scope: Installed roots from common tools, other tools, SFTP, tmux and every capture dependency group; recursive installed providers and dependencies
implementation.transport: Bounded SSH binary exec; no SFTP dependency, no repository download
implementation.formats: Native OpenWrt gzip-tar IPK and APK v2 accepted by APK 3.0.5
implementation.apk_trust: --allow-untrusted for this local restore only; --no-network; no system trust changes
implementation.protection: ROM firmware hashes, board/release/kernel identity, intersecting hashed hardware address; package hashes; private workspace; additive-only native plan
implementation.existing_packages: Retain existing versions; native solver must satisfy constraints without replacing existing packages
implementation.excluded: Router login credentials, core network configuration, package database replacement, unrelated software, runtime private data
implementation.builtin: Firmware-provided unchanged packages are recorded as prerequisites instead of copying their files
implementation.lifecycle: Resident owner worker, bounded operation, cancellation before install, noninterruptible native write, final temporary cleanup, shared dependency status reconciliation
implementation.memory: Chunked transfers, streamed payload inspection, bounded metadata and archive sizes

windows_related_tests.suite: catalog, snapshots, binary transfer, service, dependency sync, group controls, page/log layout, partial install/uninstall

verification.native_registration: Both native-generated databases were re-read to check file ownership, install scripts and APK triggers; installer scripts themselves were disabled in isolated roots
verification.visual: Rendered and inspected shared light/dark cards at 100 and 150 percent; labels and both buttons visible
native_findings_fixed: APK v2 per-file SHA1 PAX fields required; outer integrity remains SHA256
OpenWrt IPK outer container must be gzip-tar, not Debian ar

not_verified: Actual factory reset followed by offline restoration
Actual shared-library ABI and service start on customer firmware
Maintainer hook execution on a real router
Debian desktop Qt startup/card/shutdown; isolated native core tests do not constitute desktop verification
device_acceptance: Back up on a spare router and verify the file is complete
Only then reset that same unchanged firmware; reconnect and confirm SSH identity through the existing login flow
Disconnect internet while keeping the LAN management link; restore and verify reported skipped and installed dependencies
Repeat restore; no reinstall should be requested; test actual selected tools
risks: Partial native-install failure has no automatic rollback; report incomplete results and inspect before retry
Private backup may include package-owned tool configuration; keep it private
Unregistered hand-copied tools are not claimed as registered package backups
Unavailable ROM metadata or stable hardware identity is rejected; no guess or force bypass
validation_artifacts: Generated native binaries and extracted build trees cleaned after validation; summaries, source archive hashes, scripts, logs and screenshots retained

findings_fixed.issue: Deleted uci-defaults initialization payload was silently omitted
findings_fixed.fix: Fail incomplete capture with the missing path; require every rebuilt owned file to be captured or proven a directory

findings_fixed.issue: Status records omit original Require-User and other control fields
findings_fixed.fix: Read and identity-check retained installed control records, merge them with current status, remove stale original archive sizes and digests

findings_fixed.issue: APK installed version alone could mask broken files, scripts, or xattrs after restoration
findings_fixed.fix: Validate final APK installed-package health flags before reporting completion

debian12_pure_business_tests.namespace_isolation: Only capture_services package initializer bypassed because Debian lacks PySide6; production business modules executed

limitations: Original initialization scripts deleted by installation cannot be reconstructed from installed files alone; such incomplete captures now stop rather than claiming success
Native APK/opkg isolated installation proofs predate this reaudit; not repeated after these metadata and completion-check changes
Native installer hooks were registered and re-read previously but not executed in isolated installer tests
No real router factory reset and offline restore acceptance has been performed
No Debian12 desktop/UI acceptance; PySide6 unavailable in current WSL environment
Whole-worktree diff check reports pre-existing trailing whitespace in unrelated packet_capture_page.py; unrelated edits preserved
